title: A flat module with nonzero closed fibres is faithfully flat
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $M$ a flat $A$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] such that for every maximal ideal $\mathfrak n\subset A$ one has $\mathfrak nM
eq M$ (equivalently $M\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak n)=M/\mathfrak nM
eq0$). Then $M$ is a faithfully flat $A$-module [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map]. In particular, if $A$ is a local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_A$, a flat $A$-module $M$ with $M/\mathfrak m_AM
eq0$ is faithfully flat.
